problem:
Title: Locally Euclidean Space has Countable Local Basis Homeomorphic to Open Balls

Let $M$ be a [[Definition:Locally Euclidean Space|locally Euclidean space]] of some dimension $d$.

Let $m \in M$.

Then: 
:there exists a [[Definition:Countable|countable]] [[Definition:Local Basis|local basis]] $\family{U_n}_{n \in \N}$ of $m$ where each $U_n$ is the [[Definition:Homeomorphism|homeomorphic]] [[Definition:Image|image]] of an [[Definition:Open Ball|open ball]] of $\R^d$
